_about: Which engine wakes each agent - read by scripts/wake.py, the one place
that starts an agent's model. An agent not listed runs on openclaw
(OpenRouter, paid per token), exactly as before this file existed.
model: haiku, sonnet, opus, or a full claude-... id.
max_turns: the most turns one wake may take (default 60).
fallback: "openclaw" (default) sends the wake through OpenRouter when
the plan refuses it before it starts (login rejected, usage limit);
Check before moving an agent:  python3 scripts/wake.py check
See what runs where:           python3 scripts/wake.py engines
bolt is plain code; only its news book asks the plan one question a time
(wake.py ask), at most 5 a day - bolt.py NEWS_WAKES_PER_DAY.
coach is coach.py's Sunday review: one question on Sonnet a week, no tools,
and it only proposes - nothing it says changes a rule.
